name: trading-model
description: Stochastic-calculus trading model with NASDAQ data adapters and Node agent orchestrator

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/market-data && npm run build -w packages/strategies && npm run build -w packages/orchestrator && npm run build -w packages/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/market-data && npm run test -w packages/strategies && npm run test -w packages/orchestrator && cd packages/core-math && python3 -m pytest -q
